blocks.title: Business
blocks.text: Lateral Fulfillment, owned by a private equity firm, needed to build a high-converting, premium brand to attract top-tier ecommerce partners in the U.S.

blocks.title: Problem
blocks.text: They needed clarity in messaging, credibility in presentation, and a complete go-to-market system that could generate and close deals.

blocks.title: Solution
blocks.text: We refined their positioning to stand out in a crowded market while speaking directly to fast growth DTC ecommerce brands looking to grow by optimizing fulfillment through Section 321.

carousel.title: Target Personas for Strategic Positioning
carousel.text: We created detailed target personas to guide Lateral Fulfillment’s positioning, messaging and go to market efforts.

carousel.title: Compelling Copy & User Friendly Wireframes
carousel.text: Clear and compelling copy was created to what Lateral Fulfillment does, how it works and their unique advantage, supported by user-friendly wireframes.

carousel.title: Custom Branded Icons & Illustrations
carousel.text: We designed custom line icons and isometric illustrations that visually represented Lateral’s key service offerings, adding brand consistency and visual appeal to the website.

carousel.title: Illustrating the Fulfillment Process
carousel.text: A custom isometric graphic that visually simplifies Lateral’s Section 321 fulfillment process, helping users understand complex logistics with ease.

carousel.title: Smart Design for an Enhanced User Experience
carousel.text: We designed website pages that highlight Lateral Fulfillment’s smarter approach and deliver a delightful user experience that included a dark / light mode toggle throughout the entire website.

carousel.title: Interactive Animations to Boost Exploration
carousel.text: We integrated animations and interactive objects associated with logistics like globes, freight containers and packages throughout the website to enhance user experience and encourage deeper exploration.

carousel.title: Mobile Friendly, Responsive Web Development
carousel.text: The website is responsive and optimized for mobile users, providing a seamless experience across all devices.

carousel.title: The Smarter Way to Fulfill Explainer Video
carousel.text: We created a mobile-optimized video that breaks down the complex fulfillment process in a clear, engaging way, showcasing Lateral’s brand positioning.

carousel.title: Interactive Product Demo for Building Trust
carousel.text: A hands-on product demo that demonstrates how Lateral’s fulfillment program works, building trust and credibility with potential partners.

carousel.title: Educational Guides Optimized for Conversion
carousel.text: We developed educational guides for each stage of the funnel to educate DTC brand decision makers that logically lead them to the next stage of the funnel.

carousel.title: 3 Step Lead Generation Funnel
carousel.text: We created a simple, effective lead generation funnel to capture website visitors and convert them into leads. We used Make.com as an interim solution to deliver the emails while HubSpot was being setup.
